nodes.doc: The Exodra-side READ layer over the oimdb store: every collection + its named indexes as a facade.

nodes.label: current
nodes.doc: Module singleton — set by the entry once, read by lazy page chunks.

nodes.label: editTaskRequested
nodes.doc: Task FIELD edits (title/priority/label) — routed through the task neuron like every other task mutation, NOT the generic reference bus, so tasks have exactly one owner and the ref bus can never write to an orchestrated collection.

nodes.label: EMPTY_OUTLET
nodes.doc: SSR via @exodra/ssr.

nodes.label: Label
nodes.doc: Categorical label (bug / feature / chore …) — one per task.

nodes.label: mountApp
nodes.doc: Boots the client SPA: one shared runtime, a browser-history router, and the shell.

nodes.label: NavItem
nodes.doc: Each page is a separate dynamic import → its own vite chunk.

nodes.label: onScreenReadout
nodes.doc: A decoupled readout: it reads ONLY the shared viewport object — no props, no reference to the list.

nodes.label: page
nodes.doc: Each page module default-exports `() => schema` (length 0 — directly callable for SSR).

nodes.label: readState
nodes.doc: Read the snapshot @exodra/ssr embedded under the 'workspace' key.

nodes.label: ReferenceEntityName
nodes.doc: Entities that are plain reference data — CRUD'd directly through the generic reference neuron.

nodes.label: refUpsertRequested
nodes.doc: Reference-data commands — plain CRUD for the non-orchestrated entities ONLY (tags, labels, members, teams, projects, milestones, statuses).

nodes.label: registerOimdbDevtools
nodes.doc: Register the oimdb collections + derived indexes with the devtools registry so the @oimdb/mcp server (and the devtools UI) can introspect live store state.

nodes.label: row
nodes.doc: Activity records are append-only and immutable, so a build-time snapshot is correct forever — no per-field bindable needed.

nodes.label: rowFor
nodes.doc: A single virtualized row — built once per pk while it is inside the window.

nodes.label: scrolled
nodes.doc: The two mutations this page makes — moving the scroll window and starring a row — are cnstra commands, so (exactly like the workspace) nothing writes to the store directly and the CNS drain is the single commit point.

nodes.label: shellView
nodes.doc: The persistent layout: sidebar nav (active link derived from router.location), a topbar with a live stat, an error banner bound to the CNS validation channel, and the #outlet element where lazily-loaded page chunks are mounted/swapped.

nodes.label: Status
nodes.doc: A workflow status column (Backlog / In progress / Review / Done …).

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY
nodes.doc: Client-side persistence: the oimdb store serializes to JSON (the same getAll()/upsertMany() round-trip used for SSR) and rides in localStorage, so edits survive a reload.

nodes.label: Swatchable
nodes.doc: The shared shape of a "swatch" reference entity (tags carry `label`, labels carry `name`; both carry `id` + `color`).

nodes.label: swatchEditor
nodes.doc: A small generic editor for a "swatch + name" reference collection (tags/labels).
